accommodation_page.title: Accommodation
accommodation_page.space_colony_tagline: ~Stylish Stay in Tokyo | Anime & Culture Hub~
accommodation_page.space_colony_desc1: Step into Space Colony Tokyo, a bold and futuristic apartment inspired by classic Japanese mecha anime. Located in Ikebukuro, one of Tokyo's major transport hubs, you'll enjoy easy access to Shinjuku, Shibuya, Akihabara, and beyond. Immerse yourself in Tokyo's vibrant culture with anime stores, arcades, shopping.
accommodation_page.space_colony_desc2: The interiors feature striking, tri-color walls and custom artwork, creating a unique space-colony atmosphere that's both bold and comfortable. Perfect for anime fans, design lovers, and travelers seeking a one-of-a-kind Tokyo experience.
accommodation_page.location_1_desc: a major terminal station with direct access to airports, bullet trains, and top sightseeing spots.
accommodation_page.location_2_desc: home to Animate (Japan's largest Anime Center, Mega Tokyo, and T-World.
accommodation_page.location_3_desc: endless options for food, shopping, and nightlife.
accommodation_page.room_feature_1: Unique design: Interiors inspired by the colors and atmosphere of classic Japanese mecha anime.
accommodation_page.room_feature_2: Space-colony theme: Futuristic yet bold, immersive, yet comfortable.
accommodation_page.room_feature_3: Fully equipped: Wi-Fi, air conditioning, kitchen essentials, and cozy beds.
accommodation_page.room_feature_4: In the heart of Tokyo's anime culture: perfect for fans and travelers seeking a unique Tokyo experience.

about_page.person_1_bio:
Born and raised in Tokyo.
After studying abroad, he realized how meaningful it is to feel welcomed in a new place.
So, together with Yasuhiko, he created this Airbnb.
This Airbnb is part of my journey on social media, building a brand, sharing his story on social media.
